strings.FSP_NEU_CONTROL: {fsp_getnamedef} is controlled by A NEUTRAL PARTY.
strings.FSP_no_regrets_desc: Ask, and Eichmann will characterize himself as a dedicated bureaucrat and loyal National Socialist. However, this is not the whole picture; he is also a cold-blooded, hateful ideologue, and encourages his men to follow suit.
strings.FSP_second_solution_desc: Eichmann's mission in Prussia is simple: to permanently excise all degeneracy. He has returned to his old methods of extermination and broadened their scope to include all who fail to live up to the ideals of the SS.
